paper_title: Strong constraints on decay and annihilation of dark matter from heating of gas-rich dwarf galaxies
notes: Paper's primary results are DM decay lifetime and annihilation cross-section limits from heating of Leo T gas-rich dwarf galaxy. Recast to ALP-photon coupling in Fig. 4 (best limit for ma ~ 30 eV - keV). Data points are approximate estimates read from Fig. 4 (Leo T gas temp bound, Tgas=6100 K, solid black curve); precise tabulated values not available in text. The paper also constrains many other DM models (Higgs portal scalars, sterile neutrinos, dark neutrons), so multiple couplings discussed - AxionPhoton chosen as the enum-matching coupling. Halo-based astrophysical bound (not haloscope), so no DM density flag set.
